mechanism_definitions.hook_generator: projected one-round elementary generator with residual data component weight at least 2
mechanism_definitions.measurement_class_generator: projected one-round elementary generator with zero residual data component E=0
mechanism_definitions.mixed_multi_round_configuration: occupied locations use at least two distinct rounds
mechanism_definitions.needs_measurement_configuration: contains at least one measurement-class generator
mechanism_definitions.no_hook_configuration: every selected projected generator has residual weight at most 1
mechanism_definitions.single_round_configuration: all occupied locations have one common round index
